apps.name: BYD Sea Lion 06
apps.localizedDescription: Компаньйон для BYD Sea Lion 06: стан авто, клімат, сидіння, камери.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- **Wi-Fi and LTE in the companion header** — the head unit publishes `wifi_connected`/`wifi_level` (0..3) and
  `lte_connected`/`lte_level` (0..4), discovered in HA as «WiFi Connected», «WiFi Signal Level», «LTE Connected»,
  «LTE Signal Level». The phone apps and the HA card show them after «Онлайн · оновлено …» as in Figma: Wi-Fi arcs and
  LTE bars by level; no Wi-Fi = grey Wi-Fi with «!», LTE not working = red crossed circle; hidden while the car is
  offline or the data is stale.

### Fixed
- **«Припарковано … · заряд без змін» while the car charged** — the keep-alive helper re-read SOC only in a periodic
  wake window, and on Wi-Fi those are skipped, so `park_soc_drop` stayed 0 (HA, 2026-11-11: SOC 79 → 87 % while
  parked, drop 0 all day). The helper now refreshes SOC on every tick while parked, and the app and the HA card show
  a gain as «+8% заряду» instead of «заряд без змін».
